intro: Cinq chest of drawer blends clean geometry with modern adaptability. Elevated on a tubular steel frame and finished in a neutral tone, it anchors storage spaces while keeping essentials organised.

features.title: Sleek modern finish with a neutral palette
features.text: The neutral tones of Cinq create a soft contrast that suits both minimal and layered interiors. Its understated colour story keeps your space cohesive.

features.title: Elegant tubular steel frame for refined support
features.text: The elevated steel base introduces contemporary character while providing strong structural integrity.

features.title: Drawer and hinged storage for layered organisation
features.text: A combination of drawers and hinged compartments allows you to separate daily-use items from bulk storage. This thoughtful configuration keeps essentials accessible yet concealed.

features.title: Raised profile for visual lightness
features.text: The elevated stance of this Cinq chest unit enhances airflow and makes cleaning beneath effortless. It contributes to a lighter, uncluttered room aesthetic.

features.title: Compact module for flexible placement
features.text: This Cinq unit can function independently or alongside other Cinq units, adapting easily as storage needs evolve.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
